为什么老傲要写我是光明神（第1页）
不知不觉，老傲距离第一本小说在2004年4月1日上传到今天，已经整整十五年零十天了。
在这十五年里，一路见证了网文从小众崛起到影视屏幕上。
记得当时写小说，思想单纯，文笔稚嫩，从未考虑过利益、套路、或是其它任何杂质。
只简简单单地想着，把自己最喜欢的东西表达出来。
但是随着网文愈发繁荣，逐渐被主流社会了解到接受，随后智能手机普及无线端读者量爆发，再到游戏改编和影视改编，继而大量资本进行追捧。
这让老傲在写作过程中，不知不觉会去迎合无线端方向读者心理，考虑是否符合游戏改编，作品能不能往影视化改编方向等等。
如此愈发心境浮躁，如何能写出真正自己喜欢的作品？
在开这本新书前，老傲自己考虑和构架了好几个题材。有契合游戏改编的，也有往影视化方向走的。
在这过程中，老傲犹豫了很久，也想了很久。
《我是光明神》，这个题材既不适合影视改编，也不适合游戏改编，更不是什么迎合无线端的玄幻套路文。
只是简简单单的，老傲自己很喜欢。
只是洗一洗内心，擦一擦眼睛，不再被所谓的大趋势，大流行去左右作品。
在此，老傲也要感谢阅文的胡说主编和太山主编，他们也都非常支持老傲的想法，并给予了非常大的支持。
喜欢的读者呢，多多投票支持一下哟。
（顺便再给自己做个广告，由2008年创作的拙作《老婆爱上我》，改编的连续剧《赖猫的狮子倒影》年前已经顺利杀青，目前在后期制作阶段了男主朱亚文，女主杨子姗，算是一部大制作了。顺利的话今年会播出，等播出后大家多多支持哟~）

> Why did Lao Ao write that I am the God of Light (Page 1)
Why did Lao Ao write that I am the God of Light (Page 1)
Unconsciously, it has been fifteen years and ten days since Lao Ao uploaded his first novel on April 1, 2004.
In the past fifteen years, we have witnessed the rise of online literature from a niche to the film and television screen.
I remember that when I was writing novels, my thoughts were simple and my writing was immature. I never considered interests, routines, or any other impurities.
Just think about it and express what you like most.
However, as Internet literature became more and more prosperous, it was gradually understood and accepted by mainstream society. Then the popularity of smartphones and wireless terminals led to an explosion in readers, and then to game adaptations and film and television adaptations, and then a large amount of capital was pursued.
This makes Lao Ao unknowingly cater to the psychology of wireless readers during the writing process, and consider whether it is suitable for game adaptation, whether the work can be adapted into film and television, etc.
How can I write a work that I really like when my mood becomes more and more impetuous?
Before opening this new book, Lao Ao himself considered and framed several themes. Some are suitable for game adaptation, and some are in the direction of film and television.
During this process, Lao Ao hesitated and thought for a long time.
"I Am the God of Light" is not suitable for film and television adaptation, nor is it suitable for game adaptation, nor is it a fantasy routine that caters to wireless terminals.
It's just simple, Lao Ao likes it very much.
Just cleanse your heart, wipe your eyes, and no longer let the so-called big trends and pandemics influence your works.
Here, Lao Ao would also like to thank Editor-in-Chief Hu Shuo and Editor-in-Chief Taishan of Yuewen. They are also very supportive of Lao Ao’s ideas and have given them great support.
Readers who like it, please vote for it.
